description: Market price statistics for a cohort of active sale listings: min, max, average, median, p25/p75 and counts, plus average price by production year. Optionally pass a listing slug (slug) to see how that listing compares to the cohort (percentile and deviation from median). Use this to answer "is this a good price?".

make.description: Cohort make, e.g. "Adria". Use list_camper_makes to resolve names.

maxSample.description: Maximum listings to sample for statistics.

slug.description: Sale listing slug to compare against the cohort.

yearMax.description: Latest production year in the cohort.

yearMin.description: Earliest production year in the cohort.

name: analyze_camper_prices
title: Analyze camper prices
